topics.topic: Whether EDGE_DELIVERY_RULES row selection must match the computed guard_matches value
questions: Must the selected EDGE_DELIVERY_RULES row also have guard_matches equal to the computed guard_matches value, or is guard_matches intentionally not part of row selection?

quotes: MUST give each EdgeState the delivery of the one imported EDGE_DELIVERY_RULES row whose source_succeeded equals whether the edge source concluded as ElementSucceeded and whose guard_present equals whether the edge has a guard; guard_matches is false unless both source_succeeded and guard_present are true, and otherwise equals whether the canonical JSON text of the source's guard_port value equals its guard_value.
judgement.divergence: One implementer selects the row using source_succeeded, guard_present, and the computed guard_matches; another selects using only source_succeeded and guard_present, potentially choosing a row with a different delivery. Downstream nodes and flow-output consumers notice whether the edge is enabled, disabled, or undecided.
judgement.why: The text computes guard_matches but does not state that the selected EDGE_DELIVERY_RULES row must match it.
